mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking.rejected_milestone (id, tracking_number, kind, location_unlocode, occurred_at, source_kind, source_ref, acquired_at, data_source_id, external_id, reason, recorded_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{trackingNumber}, #{kind}, #{locationUnlocode}, #{occurredAt}, #{sourceKind}, #{sourceRef}, #{acquiredAt}, #{dataSourceId}, #{externalId}, #{reason}, #{recordedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracking.rejected_milestone WHERE source_kind = #{sourceKind} AND source_ref = #{sourceRef}
